entities.name: DES switch and recurrent ISR
observations: ISAR-DESIRE 2 randomized 450 patients with sirolimus-DES restenosis; repeat sirolimus versus switch to paclitaxel DES yielded 6–8-month binary restenosis of 19.6% versus 20.6% (P=0.69) and 12-month TLR of 16.6% versus 14.6% (P=0.52), showing no significant advantage to switching.
Evidence is limited to an older open-label, two-center trial of first-generation stents and does not establish effects for contemporary DES types.

entities.name: ISR alternatives context
observations: DAEDALUS pooled individual data from 10 randomized trials (1,976 patients); paclitaxel-coated balloon had higher 3-year TLR than repeat DES overall (HR 1.32, 95% CI 1.02–1.70), but this does not compare switching versus repeating DES type.
Network meta-analysis findings versus balloon angioplasty do not establish superiority of switching DES drug type.
